name: Masenen & Tomnyeon
source:
White Chocolate and Dark Chocolate
The last thing Tsukino did before he disappeared. These two are currently working at the "Good Bathhouse".
Sometimes they help Kagayaki and Tin-Qin with things. They have common interests.
